subject.title: fix(core): surface non_deliverable_terminal_turn as outbound fallback to channel plugins

question: Should confirmed `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` outcomes bypass `message_tool_only` suppression with one generic core fallback, or should failure visibility remain plugin-owned through a future SDK contract?
rationale: Both choices define the ongoing delivery contract for external channel plugins; tests can validate either implementation but cannot choose the user-visible policy.

options.title: Approve the narrow core fallback
options.body: Allow exactly one sanitized core failure payload only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, contingent on real channel proof and focused regression coverage.

options.title: Design a plugin-owned failure hook
options.body: Pause this branch and define a documented plugin SDK terminal-failure callback so each channel controls the fallback presentation and delivery semantics.

options.title: Preserve strict tool-only suppression
options.body: Do not send automatic core fallback replies in this mode and require affected plugins to provide their own visible recovery path.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow core fallback
recommendation.body: Allow exactly one sanitized core failure payload only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, contingent on real channel proof and focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review history identifies steipete as the strongest available routing candidate for the auto-reply and follow-up delivery contract.
